newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Delta Air Lines started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Delta Air Lines started.

text.p: -- NatWest Securities analyst Susan Donofrio said she initiated coverage of Delta Air Lines Inc with a buy rating.
-- "We see earnings momentum for Delta as the airline continues to successfully implement new ways to enhance its core business and keep its cost structure low," Donofrio said in a research note.
-- "On a valuation basis, we have estimated that the stock should be trading between $70 and $105. The stock is clearly undervalued," she said.
